title: Record the copied value that halves register 360
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 11810, register 356 holds `1` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- Event 11809 copies that `1` from register 360. Event 11810 multiplies the copy by `-1/2` and contributes `-1/2` to register 360.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The addition that first placed this `1` into register 360 is not traced.
